description: Source code for a Document Store Vector component implementing the INode interface, managing document storage and retrieval with vector embeddings, including methods for listing stores and initializing vector store instances.

classes.name: DocStore_VectorStores
classes.description: A class implementing a document vector store node with methods for listing and initializing document store instances.

methods.name: loadMethods.listStores
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and returns a list of document stores from the database based on search options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the document store vector node, loads configurations, creates embedding and vector store instances, and returns the retriever or vector store object.
